briefdescription.para: Creates the compile-time constant of an integer literal.

detaileddescription.para: The value is checked by math::integer_magnitude(), which accepts, for the signed types, the absolute value of the minimum; this value does not fit in T, so it is represented by integral_min_magnitude<T>.

T
The integral type of the literal.
Cs
The characters of the literal, as received by a literal operator template.
Used by the integer literal operators (_i, _u8, etc.).

simplesect.para: An integral_constant with the value of the literal, or, when the value is the absolute value of the minimum of a signed T, an integral_min_magnitude<T>, valid only when negated.

briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ value wrappers.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declarations for the value wrapper types used within the µTest++ framework: the op base struct, shared by all the framework expression types, the value_base common base, the compile-time integral_constant and floating_point_constant types, created by the literals, the run-time value<T> type, named by the to_* and _* aliases, and the named_bool type, created by the _b literal.

The wrappers carry the operands of the comparisons, so that the comparators can apply the type-specific rules (for example the precision of the floating point values) and the reporters can print the actual values.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since users name these types only through the literals and the aliases, never directly.
All header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is intended for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
